issues.detail: The instructions lack explicit handling of error scenarios and edge cases such as API failures or missing parameters.
The skill is tightly coupled to Hermes Agent and its specific plugin architecture, limiting portability to other AI agents.

scenarios.name: search-tweets-and-read-replies
scenarios.rationale: Response A largely follows the required sequence and provides a summary, but omits the original tweet text; Response B fails to meet any rubric criteria.

scenarios.name: list-user-followers-page-by-page
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fail to provide the required follower usernames, pagination details, and total follower count as specified in the rubric.

scenarios.name: create-keyword-monitor-with-approval
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets the rubric requirements, while Response A does not.
